mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_session ( session_id, user_id, access_jti, refresh_jti, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, device, ip, user_agent, status, login_time, last_seen_time, logout_time, expire_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{accessJti}, #{refreshJti}, #{accessTokenHash}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{device}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{status}, #{loginTime}, #{lastSeenTime}, #{logoutTime}, #{expireAt}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), access_jti = VALUES(access_jti), refresh_jti = VALUES(refresh_jti), access_token_hash = VALUES(access_token_hash), refresh_token_hash = VALUES(refresh_token_hash), device = VALUES(device), ip = VALUES(ip), user_agent = VALUES(user_agent), status = VALUES(status), login_time = VALUES(login_time), last_seen_time = VALUES(last_seen_time), logout_time = NULL, expire_at = VALUES(expire_at), update_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_session SET access_jti = #{accessJti}, refresh_jti = #{refreshJti}, access_token_hash = #{accessTokenHash}, refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash}, status = 1, last_seen_time = NOW(), logout_time = NULL, expire_at = #{expireAt}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE auth_session SET status = #{status}, logout_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE access_token_hash = #{accessTokenHash} AND status = 1
UPDATE auth_session SET status = #{status}, logout_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1
UPDATE auth_session SET status = #{status}, logout_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
UPDATE auth_session SET last_seen_time = #{lastSeenTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS id, s.session_id AS sessionId, s.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.role AS role, s.device AS device, s.ip AS ip, s.user_agent AS userAgent, s.login_time AS loginTime, s.last_seen_time AS lastSeenTime, s.expire_at AS expireAt, s.status AS status FROM auth_session s LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY s.last_seen_time DESC, s.login_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM auth_session WHERE status = 1 AND expire_at > NOW()

SELECT session_id AS sessionId, user_id AS userId, device AS device, ip AS ip, user_agent AS userAgent, status AS status, login_time AS loginTime, last_seen_time AS lastSeenTime, expire_at AS expireAt FROM auth_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY last_seen_time DESC, login_time DESC, id DESC
